title: About VVCE
content: VVCE stands for Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering. It was established in 1997 in Karnataka. VVCE is an autonomous institute affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), approved by AICTE and UGC, and accredited by NAAC with an A grade. The college offers six undergraduate programs, six postgraduate programs, and nine PhD research centers, with over five thousand students.

title: College Overview
content: Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering (VVCE) is a prestigious engineering college established in 1997, affiliated to VTU and accredited by NAAC with an A grade. It offers multiple engineering programs across departments like Computer Science, Electronics, Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, and Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning. The campus has modern facilities including hostels, sports courts, library, and multiple canteens.

title: How to get information
content: For detailed information, please visit the main office located in M Block, ground floor, or check the official VVCE website.

title: Alumini
content: VVCE has a strong alumini network, alumini contacts and networking opportunities can be obtained from the respective department offices.

title: Student Population
content: VVCE has a total student population of over five thousand students across undergraduate, postgraduate, and PhD programs.

title: WiFi Availability
content: WiFi is available across the VVCE campus for students and faculty. Students can access the college network for academic purposes. For WiFi login credentials, contact the department office.
